root_cause.text: The `fw_log_print_buffer` function in the IVPU driver failed to validate that the firmware-supplied `read_index` and `write_index` fields within the `vpu_tracing_buffer_header` structure were within the valid `data_size` bounds before using them as buffer offsets, permitting out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds conditional checks `if (log_start >= data_size)` and `if (log_end > data_size)` in `drivers/accel/ivpu/ivpu_fw_log.c` to clamp indices derived from `log->read_index` and `log->write_index`, directly addressing the CVE description's warning about out-of-bounds buffer access caused by invalid firmware log indices.
